name: Dyn_World_IntegrateVelocities
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc_ship_inputs. Outlined block of 00C5BB30 with the world in ESI and dt on the stack (no clean prologue; Ghidra shows unaff_ESI), body 00C41550-00C41AC8. First phase of one Dyn substep: walks the world body list at world+204h (sentinel world+208h, next at body+84h) and, for each body whose B+50h bit 4 is clear, does v += (M+50h)*dt*force (M+50h is the INVERSE mass), adds world gravity (world+04h..+0Ch) unless B+50h bit 2 is set, applies linear damping max(0,1-M[+B8h]*dt), rebuilds the world inverse inertia M+60h..+80h as sum_k Ik*(row_k (x) row_k) from M+54h..+5Ch and the body rows, does w += Iw^-1 * torque * dt, applies angular damping M+BCh, and finally, when the byte at M+B4h is set, rebuilds Iw^-1 keeping only the row-1 term (literal 0.0f multiplies on rows 0 and 2). docs/RIGID_BODY_INTEGRATION.md | Run-time evidence, packet cc_exe_2j (bsp_game.exe milestone 2j): run per unit per fixed simulation step in bsp_game.exe, 8960 times over the USN02 mission, in place of milestone 2i's explicit Euler stand-in. The hull body carries no force, no gravity and no damping there, because 00C37F40, 00C37E70, 00C37E00 and 00C37DE0 have no caller on the hull path and nothing pushes force onto the body, so the phase only rebuilds the world inverse inertia. docs/GAME_EXECUTABLE.md milestone 2j.
